purpose: Enumerate every public claim in this repository that the current release
contract (IMPROVED_PLAN.md section 1 'Meaning of exact', section 3 gates)
cannot yet support, so that no reader mistakes tolerant parity or Rust
self-determinism for equality against the pinned original.
This file is a record of what is UNPROVEN. It is not a test result and it
must never be cited as evidence that a gate passed.

claim_classes.byte_identity_across_rust_runs: Same program, two runs or two thread counts, produce identical bytes. This is determinism of the candidate. It says nothing about agreement with ANCOMBC.
claim_classes.byte_identity_across_r_versions: Same Rust binary under R 4.3.3 / 4.5.3 / 4.6.1, same BLAS, identical arrays. Still candidate-vs-candidate.
claim_classes.tolerant_parity: Approximate agreement with the pinned original under the tolerances in docs/numerical_contract.md section 4 (rtol 1e-8..1e-7, atol 1e-10) plus an enumerated rank-deficient exemption. This is NOT exactness.
claim_classes.r_relative_benchmark: A speed or memory ratio whose R arm came from reference/R/harness.R sequential stubs and/or whose two arms used different memory metrics. Invalid for P1-P5.
claim_classes.exactness_unproven: Whole-result byte equality against the installed original. No claim in this repository currently carries this.

unvalidated_claims.text: ancombc2-rs v0.1 is equivalent to ANCOMBC 2.15.2 at commit dc4febdf..., under R >= 4.5.0, seed 42.
unvalidated_claims.why_not_exact: Backed by 29-quantity parity at rtol 1e-8/1e-7 on 4 fixtures, not by whole-result byte equality. Fresh fx03 deviations recorded in IMPROVED_PLAN.md section 2: beta 2.84e-11, p 1.58e-10, q 3.89e-10.

unvalidated_claims.text: res.tsv is byte-identical at 1, 4, 8 and 16 threads; bm6 goes 13.96 s -> 4.82 s on 16 threads.
unvalidated_claims.why_not_exact: Candidate-vs-candidate only. Says nothing about equality with the original, and the timing pair was measured against the sequential R stub.

unvalidated_claims.location: docs/compatibility.md:142, docs/reference_behavior.md:377, docs/release_status.md:248, docs/reproduction.md:36, docs/reproduction.md:43, docs/reproduction.md:456
unvalidated_claims.text: R 4.3.3, 4.5.3 and 4.6.1 on the same BLAS produce bit-identical matrix output - 915 of 915 arrays.
unvalidated_claims.why_not_exact: True as stated and worth keeping, but it compares the candidate under three interpreters. It is not a cross-R universality claim for the original, and IMPROVED_PLAN.md section 1 forbids inferring support for every R >= 4.5.0 from tested versions.

unvalidated_claims.text: The foreach stub the harness needs on an older R was verified against the installed package: 38 of 38 cells, deviation 0.
unvalidated_claims.why_not_exact: This is a per-cell numeric deviation check on extracted arrays, not whole-result byte equality, and it is reported as deviation 0 against a tolerance harness. It also predates the installed-original protocol S02 requires.

unvalidated_claims.text: full grid, 252 cells x 1000 reps, both arms: 0 divergent. lfc_bias agrees on 252/252 cells.
unvalidated_claims.why_not_exact: FDR/power agreement at 3 SE is a distributional property. IMPROVED_PLAN.md section 1 rule 8 and S14 both forbid it substituting for exact per-call results.

The R arm ran through reference/R/harness.R, which installs foreach_stub and a sequential %dorng% - so the reference was single-threaded by construction. Memory mixed R gc() usage against Rust VmHWM. P1 and P2 read the same wall-time field. One repetition. Latest-row selection per (dataset, arm) permits mixing builds.

unvalidated_claims.text: the Householder factorisation is 84% of a large run.
unvalidated_claims.why_not_exact: IMPROVED_PLAN.md S17 explicitly forbids carrying this forward without reproducing it under the corrected campaign.

unvalidated_claims.text: n/a - a code defect, recorded here because it is a contract violation
unvalidated_claims.why_not_exact: The pinned original's public default is pseudo_sens = TRUE. The candidate's R wrapper declares FALSE. Any omitted-argument call therefore takes a different code path.

unvalidated_claims.text: random effects, trend, Dunnett, phyloseq/TSE input and aggregation are 'not implemented'.
unvalidated_claims.why_not_exact: Accurate for ancombc2rs and required by C2. The replacement under r/ANCOMBC/ does not exist yet.

unvalidated_claims.text: n/a - a code defect, recorded here because it is a contract violation
unvalidated_claims.why_not_exact: A JSON request/response bridge cannot carry NaN, -0.0 or +Inf, and reconstructing the R object from parsed JSON changes its structure and attributes. IMPROVED_PLAN.md section 2 lists this as a required closure.

unvalidated_claims.text: The golden fixtures were generated on R 4.3.3, one minor series below the declared minimum R >= 4.5.0.
unvalidated_claims.why_not_exact: Accurate and important: the legacy goldens are a different runtime from the one a certified profile would use. IMPROVED_PLAN.md S01 forbids reusing goldens across profiles and S04 forbids regenerating legacy fixtures in place.

unvalidated_claims.location: reference/R/oracle.R:16-26 (verify_oracle), reference/env/ORACLE.md 'How the oracle is loaded'
unvalidated_claims.text: The source is verified against the pinned commit before loading: stopifnot(identical(system("git -C reference/ANCOMBC rev-parse HEAD"), "dc4febdf..."))
unvalidated_claims.why_not_exact: reference/ANCOMBC has no .git directory (verified: `test -d reference/ANCOMBC/.git` -> absent; the vendored copy is tracked by THIS repository, and `git -C reference/ANCOMBC rev-parse HEAD` therefore resolves to this repository's HEAD e8ec02e1..., never dc4febdf...). verify_oracle() guards the git check with `have_git <- dir.exists(file.path(dir, '.git'))`, so on this checkout the commit check is silently skipped and only the DESCRIPTION Version is asserted. The real pin is the per-file digest list in reference/env/oracle.sha256, which is what S01 must verify.

preservation_rule: These files are read-only inputs to the new work. New exact fixtures, goldens and campaigns go under validation/exact/ and a new campaign directory. Nothing here may be regenerated in place.
